units.characteristics: return and I will return; God's jealous mercy toward Zion
units.gist: GEM - 'RETURN TO ME, and I WILL RETURN TO YOU'; the fathers who 'did not hear' yet at last 'repented'; the night vision of the horses, the angel's 'HOW LONG?'; 'I am EXCEEDINGLY JEALOUS for Jerusalem... I have RETURNED to Jerusalem with MERCY' - the reciprocal turn; God's jealous, comforting love

units.characteristics: God as wall of fire and glory within; the touched apple of his eye
units.gist: GEM - Jerusalem without walls, for 'I WILL BE TO HER A WALL OF FIRE all around, and I will be THE GLORY IN HER MIDST'; 'he who touches you touches the APPLE OF HIS EYE'; 'sing and rejoice... I will DWELL IN YOUR MIDST' - God's protective nearness; his people as the tenderest, most-guarded part of him

units.characteristics: the accused sinner cleansed; iniquity removed and pure vestments given
units.gist: THE GEM - Joshua the high priest 'clothed with FILTHY GARMENTS', Satan accusing; 'the LORD REBUKE you, Satan... is not this a BRAND PLUCKED FROM THE FIRE?'; 'REMOVE THE FILTHY GARMENTS from him... behold, I have TAKEN YOUR INIQUITY AWAY, and I will CLOTHE YOU WITH PURE VESTMENTS'; the Branch; iniquity removed 'in a single day'

units.characteristics: not by might but by the Spirit; not despising the day of small things
units.gist: THE GEM - the golden lampstand fed by the olive trees: 'NOT BY MIGHT, NOR BY POWER, BUT BY MY SPIRIT, says the LORD'; 'who are you, O great MOUNTAIN? before Zerubbabel you shall become a PLAIN'; 'whoever has DESPISED THE DAY OF SMALL THINGS shall rejoice' - the work done by God's Spirit, not human strength; small beginnings not despised

units.characteristics: the curse on theft and false oaths; wickedness personified and carried away
units.gist: the flying scroll = 'the CURSE that goes out over the whole land' against the thief and the false-swearer, entering and consuming his house; the woman in the basket named 'WICKEDNESS', thrust down and CARRIED AWAY to Shinar - evil named, contained, and removed from the land

units.characteristics: the four chariots as God's Spirit at rest; the priest-king and the counsel of peace
units.gist: the four chariots patrol the earth, 'set my Spirit AT REST'; the crown set on Joshua, a sign of 'the man whose name is the BRANCH... he shall build the temple, bear royal honour, and there shall be a PRIEST ON HIS THRONE, and the COUNSEL OF PEACE shall be between them both' - kingship and priesthood joined in peace

units.characteristics: religion for self vs for God; the diamond-hard heart that will not hear
units.gist: THE GEM - the fasting question answered: 'was it FOR ME that you fasted? when you eat and drink, do you not eat FOR YOURSELVES?'; true worship = 'render true judgments, show KINDNESS and MERCY, do not oppress the widow, fatherless, sojourner, poor; let none DEVISE EVIL against another IN YOUR HEART'; but 'they made their hearts DIAMOND-HARD lest they should hear'

units.characteristics: the restored community of truth and peace; fasts turned to joy; God-with-us drawing the nations
units.gist: GEM - 'I have RETURNED to Zion'; old men and children safe in the streets; 'let your hands be STRONG... FEAR NOT'; 'SPEAK THE TRUTH to one another... do not DEVISE EVIL IN YOUR HEARTS... love no false oath, for all these I HATE'; the fasts become 'SEASONS OF JOY and gladness'; 'ten men take hold of a Jew's robe: GOD IS WITH YOU'

units.characteristics: the humble king who brings peace; prisoners of hope
units.gist: THE GEM - 'REJOICE greatly, O daughter of Zion! behold, your KING is coming to you; RIGHTEOUS and HAVING SALVATION is he, HUMBLE and mounted on a DONKEY'; 'he shall speak PEACE to the nations'; 'return to your stronghold, O PRISONERS OF HOPE; I will restore to you DOUBLE' - the king whose greatness is humility and peace

units.characteristics: the shepherdless wandering; God's compassion gathering the scattered
units.gist: 'the people WANDER LIKE SHEEP; they are afflicted FOR LACK OF A SHEPHERD'; the household gods 'give empty consolation'; but 'the LORD CARES FOR his flock'; 'I will strengthen... I have COMPASSION on them, and they shall be AS THOUGH I HAD NOT REJECTED THEM'; the scattered remembering God in far countries and returning

units.characteristics: the good shepherd rejected and priced at thirty pieces; the worthless shepherd
units.gist: the shepherd allegory - tending 'the flock doomed to slaughter' with staffs Favour and Union; 'they DETESTED me'; 'give me my wages... they weighed out THIRTY PIECES OF SILVER - the lordly price at which I was priced'; thrown to the potter; the staffs broken; 'WOE TO MY WORTHLESS SHEPHERD who deserts the flock' - the good shepherd spurned, the false one who does not care

units.characteristics: the spirit of grace and mercy; the mourning look on the pierced one
units.gist: THE GEM - the God 'who FORMED THE SPIRIT OF MAN within him'; 'I will POUR OUT on the house of David a SPIRIT OF GRACE AND PLEAS FOR MERCY, so that when they LOOK ON ME, ON HIM WHOM THEY HAVE PIERCED, they shall MOURN for him as one mourns for an ONLY CHILD, and weep bitterly' - grace-given grief; repentance as looking on the wounded one and mourning

units.characteristics: the fountain opened for sin; the shepherd struck; the refined remnant
units.gist: THE GEM - 'on that day there shall be a FOUNTAIN OPENED... to CLEANSE THEM FROM SIN AND UNCLEANNESS'; idols and false prophets cut off; 'STRIKE THE SHEPHERD, and the sheep will be scattered'; the remnant refined - 'I will REFINE THEM AS SILVER... they will CALL ON MY NAME and I will answer: They are my people; and they will say, The LORD is my God'

units.characteristics: the LORD king over all; all of life consecrated - holy to the LORD
units.gist: GEM - the day of the LORD; 'the LORD will be KING over all the earth; the LORD will be ONE and his name ONE'; living waters flowing from Jerusalem; and at the last 'HOLY TO THE LORD' inscribed even on the BELLS OF THE HORSES, and every common pot 'HOLY TO THE LORD' - the sacred/secular divide abolished, all of life consecrated
